reason: No validated human pregnancy-outcome labels (data/pregnancy_labels.csv) and no trained human pregnancy model exist, so trimester-wise AUROC, AUPRC, ΔAUROC, ECE, Brier and Precision@10 cannot be computed. They are reported as unavailable, not as zero.

metric_spec.interpretation: ΔAUROC > 0 indicates trimester-specific learning; ΔAUROC ≈ 0 means the model collapses to a single-stage predictor.

uncertainty.reason: No trained model, so predictive uncertainty is undefined.

evidence_reliability.definition: Q_cov = mean over source families of (availability mask × provenance completeness)
